html:
SMTO-SKL-0138 — SMTO couldn't download that file from Slack

GUID: b175c7b3-4bab-5ca2-87ab-e690ec848555
Slug: slack-file-download-failed
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: slack

What happened

  • The download from Slack was refused or stopped partway, so SMTO didn't save the file. No partial copy was kept.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the file in Slack with the connected account to make sure it's still there and you can view it. Slack refuses the download if the account can't reach the file.
  2. Check that the computer running SMTO has a working internet connection. A dropped connection stops the download partway.
  3. Ask the Agent to download the file again. Downloading only reads from Slack, so it's safe to repeat.

What success looks like

  • The downloaded file appears in the conversation.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. If you need the file urgently, download it directly from Slack.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Slack file download returned a non-200 status, could not connect, or the stream failed with a request or OS error; no artifact was published.

What this means

  • Download transfer receives an unsuccessful status or streaming fails with a request/OS error. The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Download transfer receives an unsuccessful status or streaming fails with a request/OS error.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect file access, transfer status and allowed destination host.

How to fix it

  • Verify the principal can access the exact file (slack.file_info) and that the Server host can reach files.slack.com, then repeat slack.download_file. Redirects and non-Slack hosts are never followed, so a file served through a redirect will keep failing.
  • Verify access to the exact file and retry the bounded download; redirects to unsupported hosts are not followed.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • A bounded authorized download completes without publishing partial content.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
